text: “Are you quite sure you want me?” said Mrs. Errol, with her soft, pretty smile. “Quite sure,” he said bluntly. “We have always wanted you, but we were not exactly aware of it. We hope you will come.” XV Ben took his boy and went back to his cattle ranch in California, and he returned under very comfortable circumstances. Just before his going, Mr. Havisham had an interview with him in which the lawyer told him that the Earl of Dorincourt wished to do something for the boy who might have turned out to be Lord Fauntleroy, and so he had decided that it would be a good plan to invest in a cattle ranch of his own, and put Ben in charge of it on terms which would make it pay him very well, and which would lay a foundation for his son's future.
